description: Several EU member states, reacting to both public backlash and U.S. access restrictions, continue forming bilateral and regional agreements to pool compute resources and establish sovereign data-sharing frameworks outside major hyperscaler clouds. These pacts prioritize local control, auditability, and non-extradition of model weights, creating a patchwork of semi-autonomous AI infrastructure. The developments are not yet coordinated at the EU level but gain momentum as trust in external providers erodes.
